how: An authorship question receives a one-pixel contribution report and a collective maker claim, locating credit without establishing that the whole subreddit made the work.
Seeking the makers precedes naming them, so crediting includes an authorship question answered by individual and collective claims rather than only an unsolicited celebration.

statement: Inviting readers into the makers' chat during an exchange about who made the work

The invitation offers entry to a chat without asking readers to place pixels, leaving any earlier call for hands unobserved.
